name: Zorich
description: Ereth's teacher who summoned fake Phyrexian raiders to exterminate human refugees.

description_citations.text: "The Monsters of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ereth discovers Zorich's deception and takes control of the Thorn Elemental, sacrificing her life to kill Zorich.
timeline.quote: Ereth sacrifices her life by taking control of the elemental and having it kill Zorich to prevent further loss of life.
